integrity: The first-listed MSC class 03B55 and first public date 2026-09-30 were checked on the primary Cheq preprint record. Theorem 6.1, the definitions of Cheq and its two modal companions, and the finite-frame companion theorems were checked in the full primary text. Pawlowski's primary text was checked for Pi-zero-one completeness under computable many-one reductions. The remaining upper-bound arguments are explicit finite exhaustive searches.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies arithmetical complexity of validity under computable many-one reductions. It does not give resource-bounded complexity for fragments. The least-companion upper bound uses the effective enumeration of finite thickenings, and the hardness argument relies on the recent exact reduction from Medvedev logic.
title: Chequered-set logic and its extremal modal companions are Pi-zero-one complete
